title: Safco Ranger Steel 4-Post Drafting Table — 42"W × 30"D with Drawer
body_html:
A made-in-USA drafting table built for daily studio punishment.

The Ranger Steel 4-Post is a commercial-grade drafting table reinforced by a steel powder-coat frame and a 1″-thick drawing board with steel end cleats. The worksurface tilts up to 50°, a reversible steel apron doubles as a pencil ledge, and a lockable tool drawer keeps supplies close.

Key features

  • Worksurface tilts up to 50° from horizontal
  • 1″-thick drawing board with steel end cleats
  • Reversible steel apron doubles as a pencil ledge
  • Lockable tool drawer for supplies
  • Custom paint and laminate finishes available

Who it’s for

Architecture, engineering, and design studios that need a heavy-duty, made-to-order drafting surface.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
